name: Constraint Satisfaction & Constraint Programming
summary: Solving problems defined by variables, domains and constraints (scheduling, timetabling, configuration) with backtracking, propagation and modern CP/SAT solvers.

topics.name: Formulating CSPs: variables, domains and constraints
Backtracking search with variable and value ordering (MRV, degree, LCV)
Forward checking and maintaining arc consistency (MAC)
Consistency: node, arc (AC-3), path and k-consistency
Local search for CSPs: min-conflicts and tabu search
Exploiting structure: tree-structured CSPs, cutset conditioning, tree decomposition
SAT and MaxSAT encodings of constraint problems
Constraint programming solvers and languages (MiniZinc, OR-Tools CP-SAT)
Scheduling and timetabling as constraint problems
